notes.title: Patch notes : prototype v0.17b
notes.notes:
Patch notes - Prototype v0.17b - More details!

PLAYER BALANCE - 

- Starting parties always got a Priest & a Bard for better healing balance at the start.

FIXES -

- Bugfix: potential random crash during play.
- Bugfix: issue with camera on lower resolutions during the last boss fight.

notes.title: Major Version : Patch Notes Prototype version 0.17
notes.notes:
Patch notes - Prototype v0.17 - More details!

FEATURES - 

- New tentative UI update. A blend mix between the old and the new versions.
- More learning and teaching, there are new ways to help you along some mechanics with a new system to detail some spells better. Try to right-click spell buttons to learn more about mechanics like Retribution or Threat.
- The Fire Wizard forgot about his old ways. Spells have been reworked to better match the gameplay changes from previous versions.

PLAYER BALANCE - 

- Fire Wizard: New Mechanics: Flame burst. Every spell hitting a unit affected by lava burn receive additional damage.
- Fire Wizard: Instant Blaze rework : does not cost an action if it triggers Flame burst.
- Fire Wizard: Inferno rework : Flame burst damage is increased for 3 rounds.

FIXES -

- Information fixed: cooldowns and value on some spells have been fixed to match the actual values from previous patch notes.
- Bugfix: fixed an issue with localization in some part of the menu.
- Bugfix: fixed a crash when you tried to quit a game while placing the units.

notes.title: Patch notes - Prototype v0.16e
notes.notes:
Patch notes - Prototype v0.16e - The Steam Age

PLAYER BALANCE - 

- War Master: Threat Ratio from Hammer Strike raise from 3 to 4.5.

FIXES -

- Bugfix: Chatting characters not updating text properly
- Bugfix: Case where Captain Skullz would not play his attack animation
- Bugfix: pathfinding properly updates when an AI dies during the player turn.
- Bugfix: It's not possible to reroll beyond the guild funds anymore.
- Bugfix: The sound & music numbers in the options doesn't show weird variation anymore.
- Bugfix: 1080p resolution had an issue resulting in black bars on the side of the screen. You will need to reply your options to get this working for you.
- Bugfix: the options won't show the "debug" message for some resolution. If it's the case, redo your resolution options and it will fix the issue.
- Bugfix: Rare crash when using some buttons too quickly
- Bugfix: Rare crash from UI information
- Bugfix: Potential issue at the end of Groguik's figt preventing to click on the next fight buttons
- Bugfix: DPS meter position changing position in Groguik's fight.
- Bugfix: Defeat screen overlapping the buttons in some case.
- Bugfix: Fire Wizard's Lava Burn able to be stacked infinitely (no more).
- Performance: Over 600 lines of code scrapping.

notes.title: Patch notes - Prototype v0.16d
notes.notes:
Patch notes - Prototype v0.16d - The Steam Age

FEATURES -

- New sprites for Captain Skullz.

FIXES -

- Bugfix: Captain Skullz raging sprites shows over his healthbar.
- Many typos in loot names.
- Tentative Bugfix: A rare crash in a round where a character dies.
- Bugfix: Fire Wizards and Bards Damage over Time effects can now be re applied on targets.
- Bugfix: Crash when a creature died with Lava Burn applied.
